identity.operation: Reach printing of a cJSON_Raw child in an array or object.
identity.condition: A valid input and setup supplies a supported cJSON_Raw child.
identity.consequence: The child printing path cannot be reached through the harness.

requirement: If Raw children are within this target’s supported print inputs, a valid input and setup must reach printing of a Raw child.

assessment.necessity_reason: Array and object printers pass children to a value printer that supports cJSON_Raw. The source provides ways to construct and insert a Raw child, so a shallow container with one Raw child is a supported print setup. The parser cannot produce Raw, and the old harness prints only the parser result.

before.requirement: A valid input and supported setup must be able to reach printing a cJSON_Raw child in an array or object.
before.reason: The old harness passes only a parsed tree to its printers. Array and object parsing delegate child creation to parse_value, whose complete dispatch has no Raw case. The harness never constructs or inserts a Raw child.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The delegated value printer supports Raw values.
The public constructor creates a Raw item for a supported print setup.
The public helper can insert a Raw child into an object.
The complete parser dispatch cannot produce a Raw item.
Array parsing uses that dispatch for each child.
Object parsing uses that dispatch for each child.

after.requirement: A valid input and supported setup must be able to reach printing a cJSON_Raw child in an array or object.
after.reason: The added nesting guards still permit a shallow container, but the fixed harness continues to print only a parsed tree. The complete parser dispatch still cannot produce Raw, and the harness has no construction or insertion route.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The delegated value printer still supports Raw values.
The public constructor still creates a Raw item.
The public helper still inserts a Raw child into an object.
The complete parser dispatch still has no Raw case.
Array parsing still uses that dispatch for each child.
Object parsing still uses that dispatch for each child.

assessment.comparison_reason: On both sides, the same old-harness constraint blocks the same behavior: it prints only a parser-returned tree and never supplies a constructed Raw child.

necessity_evidence.reason: The print operation supports a cJSON_Raw child in an object, and the source provides a valid construction route. The fixed harness prints only parser-returned trees; parsing cannot produce Raw. The same coverage blocker exists before and after the change, so this obligation is preexisting.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: Input bytes `0000{}\0` yield a parsed object. A supported print setup would add a Raw child with `cJSON_AddRawToObject(json, "x", "1")` before printing. The fixed harness never performs that setup, so no fuzzer input reaches Raw-child printing.

scope_contract.reason: Object printing is part of the entry's primary print operation. Its child value printer accepts Raw, and the source supports adding a Raw child to the object supplied to that operation.

evidence.dependency_reason: The delegated value printer accepts and emits Raw values.
The public helper creates and inserts a Raw object child.

feasible_trigger.reason: An empty object is a finite valid input, and adding a Raw child is a supported shallow setup. The new depth guard permits that setup.

evidence.dependency_reason: The parser accepts an empty object.
The source can add the Raw child to that object.

observable_consequence.reason: No input can make the harness print a Raw object child: it prints the parser result without adding children, while object parsing obtains child types through a dispatch that has no Raw case.

evidence.dependency_reason: This is the supported Raw behavior that remains unreachable.
Object parsing delegates each child value to parse_value.
The complete parser dispatch has no Raw-producing case.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The supplied parser-route counterevidence confirms the blocker: parsing an object's child calls parse_value, which never creates Raw. Printing an ordinary parsed value reaches a different print_value case. The complete harness has no insertion or other setup route.

evidence.dependency_reason: Every parsed object child uses that dispatch.

identity_preserved.reason: Before and after, the same obligation is Raw-child printing through object print_value, blocked by the same parse-only harness setup. The added depth guard does not exclude a shallow object.

evidence.dependency_reason: The before printer supports the same Raw child.
The after printer supports the same Raw child.
The before parser cannot produce Raw.
The after parser cannot produce Raw.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Print a cJSON_Raw child in an object through print_value.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Parse `{}`, then add a Raw child with `cJSON_AddRawToObject(json, "x", "1")` before printing.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The harness prints the parser-returned object directly.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: The Raw case of print_value cannot be reached for an object child.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: None: object parsing cannot create Raw, and the complete harness has no Raw construction or insertion call.
